title: CS daily scratchpad  account reminders & QBR prep
content:
Date: 2026-06-29
Owner: Noah Bennett (CS) — daily scratchpad for account reminders, QBR prep, renewals, and open support follow-ups. Draft notes / to-dos — informal.

TOP PRIORITIES (today)
- Prep QBR for EvernoteCloud (internal dry-run 07/02) — finalize slides + metrics by 07/01 EOD.
- Renewal outreach: Atlas Retail (renewal 2026-07-15) — confirm licensing add-on decision with procurement.
- Close blocker SUP-1289 for Evernote latency spikes (waiting on infra patch from eng).

ACCOUNTS HIGHLIGHT
1) EvernoteCloud (Enterprise)
   - ARR: ~$180k/year
   - Renewal: 2026-08-15 (QBR scheduled 2026-07-07)
   - Primary contacts: Lisa Park (Customer Success Lead), Raj Patel (CTO)
   - Health: Yellow — usage up but p95 latency spikes last 2 weeks
   - Last touch: 2026-06-22 (postmortem sync)
   - Open items:
     * SUP-1289: intermittent tokenization error -> eng assigned (ENG-3198), ETA 6/30 for patch. Follow up if no update by EOD 6/30.
     * QBR slides: need to add "latency trend by route" and "cost per 1k tokens" slide (Aisha taking metrics).
     * Ask solutions-eng to confirm recommended quantization profile for their ded. pool (Priya).
   - Today actions:
     * 10:30AM PT — sync with Lisa (30m) to confirm QBR agenda + attendees.
     * Add usage graphs to slide deck (pull from console: per-route token/day, p95, error rate).
     * Draft talking points for latency mitigation & planned patch.

2) Atlas Retail (Mid-market)
   - ARR: ~$48k/year
   - Renewal: 2026-07-15 (renewal outreach due 2026-06-30)
   - Contacts: Kevin Morales (Product Lead), Sarah Liu (Procurement)
   - Health: Green
   - Open items:
     * Confirm pricing tier for additional seats — Sarah to confirm by 6/30.
     * Prepare renewal quote PDF (templates in Confluence).
   - Today actions:
     * Email Sarah draft quote + link to demo recording.
     * File renewal reminder in CRM and set up call for 07/06.

3) HelixMed (Regulated / Private)
   - ARR: ~$600k/year
   - Renewal: 2026-10-01 (long lead)
   - Contacts: Dr. Elena Ruiz (Head of AI), Marco Tan (Infra)
   - Health: Yellow/Watch — compliance asks + slow onboarding for private deploy
   - Open items:
     * Compliance docs: HICP & audit logs — legal to confirm 07/05.
     * Professional services scoping for on-prem integration (solutions-eng lead: Omar).
   - Today actions:
     * Send updated PS scoping doc to Elena (attach SOW template).

QBR PREP (Evernote & general checklist)
- Agenda (Evernote): 1) Exec summary (health + ARR) 2) Usage & growth 3) Performance (p50/p95/p99 + error rates) 4) Cost breakdown + optimization opportunities 5) Roadmap ask + support items 6) Decisions needed (renewal, burst capacity)
- Slides to update: executive summary, latency trend by route, cost per 1k tokens, roadmap/ask slide
- Data needed (owners):
  * tokens/day & active routes — Aisha
  * p95 latency (last 90d) — Eng observability (Priya to ping observability team)
  * Error rate & top error classes — Support (me)
  * Cost breakdown (hosting vs dedicated + caching impact) — Finance/Optimize (ask Liam)
- Pre-reads: share 3 days before QBR (target 07/04)
- Internal dry-run: 07/02 2pm PT (invite: Lisa, Raj optional, Aisha, Priya, Omar)

SUPPORT FOLLOW-UPS
- SUP-1289 (Evernote) — intermittent tokenization error slow path; ENG-3198 patch pending; owner: Eng (Priya flagged); follow-up target: 2026-06-30 EOD. Notes: escalate to SRE if patch misses 6/30.
- SUP-1310 (Atlas) — config mismatch causing 502s on batch endpoints; pending config roll 6/28; owner: Solutions Eng (Omar).
- SUP-1336 (HelixMed) — audit log export failing (>10GB) on private deploy; owner: Infra (Marco). Need timeline for fix before QBR planning.

MEETINGS / SCHEDULE (today)
- 09:00AM PT — standup (15m)
- 10:30AM PT — Evernote sync (30m) — agenda: confirm execs, confirm data owners, ask about additional attendees
- 12:00PM PT — lunch + doc updates
- 14:00PM PT — internal QBR dry-run prep (block 2h prep time)
- 15:30PM PT — check with Eng on SUP-1289 status (if no update by then, escalate)

PERSONAL TODOS / QUICK REMINDERS
- Update Evernote QBR deck: add charts + slides (target 07/01 EOD)
- Draft renewal email for Atlas (template in Confluence)
- Mark SUP tickets in CRM and add follow-up tasks
- Re-run NPS + CSAT snapshot for accounts in scope for QBRs (script in repo: cs-tools/nps-snapshot)
- Remind Aisha to add cost breakdown before 07/01

NOTES / QUESTIONS TO RAISE
- If ENG patch for SUP-1289 is delayed, what's our fallback? Can we route traffic to a more stable model variant? (Ask Runtime team)
- For HelixMed private deploy, confirm if additional HSM integration will delay renewal decision.

RANDOM SCRATCH / TO SELF
- Quick templates: renew-email-v2 (confluence) | qbr-slide-template-2026 | ps-scope-template-legal-v1
- Slack pings: #acct-evernote-thread (post update after 10:30AM sync)
- Keep notes tidy for handover if out next week (vacation 07/10–07/16)

END OF NOTE (informal)

-- Noah
